findings.claim: The file tree already lists ./docs/ui-design-authority.md, yet the diff adds it as 'new file mode 100644'; if the tree is pre-change, the page previously existed and its content is being silently replaced with no removed-lines visibility, and if the tree is post-change, the .refiner/ directory the diff creates is missing from it — either way the packet's repository shape contradicts the diff.
findings.evidence: file_tree contains './docs/ui-design-authority.md' (between ./docs/UI_DESIGN.md and ./docs/VISUALIZATION_SYSTEM_GUIDE.md) but contains no '.refiner' entry; the diff declares both 'docs/ui-design-authority.md' and '.refiner/artifacts/amend-goal4-base-ui-divergence/refinement_log.md' as new files.
findings.suggested_fix: Clarify whether the authority page pre-existed; if it did, present the change as a modification showing the removed content, and reconcile the file tree with the actual set of created paths.

findings.claim: Criterion 2.2 ('record the required refinement and review evidence') is satisfied only by SHA-256 references to four review-artifact JSON files plus plan/decision-log/vendored-standard hashes that live in untracked KBD working state and are not part of this change, so the recorded evidence is non-reproducible from any checkout — the same dangling-evidence defect class the change's own Round 2 blocked on for the authority page, remediated there but left in place for the verification trail.
findings.evidence: verification.md 'Normalized review artifacts are stored under .kbd-orchestrator/phases/uar-uiux-full-migration-2026-08/review/amend-goal4-base-ui-divergence/' with four SHA-256 hashes; verification.md itself states 'The active phase control-plane files are untracked in this working tree'; none of those files appear in the diff or in files.txt.
findings.suggested_fix: Apply the change's own portability rule to the review evidence: commit the normalized findings artifacts (or self-contained excerpts) under the OpenSpec change directory, keeping KBD paths as provenance only.

findings.claim: The 'Files: PASS' section asserts that docs/ui-design-authority.md 'links to the D1 decision record,' which reads as the KBD decision-log link that the same log's Round-2 remediation entry says was deliberately removed in favor of an internal anchor plus plaintext provenance, leaving the validation statement stale or ambiguous.
findings.evidence: refinement_log.md Files: PASS bullet: 'docs/ui-design-authority.md exists, is non-empty, and links to the D1 decision record.' vs. Review remediation bullet: 'The page now carries D1's rationale, links to it internally, and records the KBD path as plaintext provenance.'
findings.suggested_fix: Reword the Files: PASS bullet to 'links internally to a self-contained D1 rationale and retains the decision-log path as plaintext provenance' so the log is internally consistent.
